primaryChecks.text: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
primaryChecks.previousContext: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
primaryChecks.nextContext: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know the LORD, nor the work which he had done for Israel.
